Could you confirm whether the Overleaf template provided on your website is still valid, or has it been updated recently?

 Sincerely,
 Dr. Fiona Zhang
 Peking University

 --- Email In ---
 Subject: Re: Question About Overleaf Template for Journal Submission

 Dear Dr. Zhang,

 Thank you for choosing to submit your manuscript to the Journal of Machine Learning Systems (JMLS). This template is designed to help authors prepare manuscripts in accordance with our current formatting requirements. Please read all instructions carefully and refer to this template throughout the preparation of your submission.

 This template is provided for use with Overleaf and LaTeX. It includes all required structural elements, section headings, and style guidelines.

 ------------------------------------------------------------
 1. GENERAL GUIDELINES
 ------------------------------------------------------------

 - Manuscripts must be written in clear, concise English.
 - All submissions should be prepared using this Overleaf template.
 - The main document must be compiled as a single PDF file.
 - Figures, tables, and supplementary material should be embedded within the manuscript, not submitted as separate files.
 - All references must conform to the journal’s citation style (see Section 9).
 - Maximum length: Regular articles should not exceed 12 pages (excluding references and appendices); short communications are limited to 6 pages.

 2. MANUSCRIPT STRUCTURE
 ------------------------------------------------------------

 The following sections are required, in order:

 1. Title Page
 2. Abstract
 3. Keywords
 4. Introduction
 5. Related Work
 6. Methods
 7. Results
 8. Discussion
 9. Conclusion
 10. Acknowledgements (optional)
 11. References
 12. Appendices (if applicable)

 Each section should begin with the corresponding heading.

 3. Include the following information on the title page:

 - Full title of the manuscript (bold, size 16pt)
 - List of authors (full names; corresponding author indicated with an asterisk)
 - Affiliations (include institution name, city, country)
 - Corresponding author email address
 - Date of submission

 **Deep Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Vehicle Navigation**

 Fiona Zhang\textsuperscript{1,*}, Wei Li\textsuperscript{1}, Mark Chen\textsuperscript{2}

 \textsuperscript{1}Department of Computer Science, Peking University, Beijing, C
